The test image shows a corn leaf with elongated pale yellow/tan streaks running parallel to the veins. Top candidates: Stewart's Disease, Goss's Wilt, Northern Leaf Blight, Gray Leaf Spot, Maize Streak Virus.

Now viewing reference images one at a time:
Very strong visual match to the test image - same elongated pale/tan streaks along the leaf. Now checking Goss's Wilt:
Goss's Wilt shows broad brown blight with wavy edges - very different from the test image. Checking Gray Leaf Spot:
Gray Leaf Spot shows small rectangular lesions, not the long continuous streaks in the test image. Checking Northern Leaf Blight:
Northern Leaf Blight shows discrete cigar-shaped lesions, not continuous streaks like the test image. Checking Maize Streak Virus:
Maize Streak Virus shows dense fine striping across the whole leaf - very different. Checking Maize Dwarf Mosaic Virus:
Maize Dwarf Mosaic shows mosaic pattern, not matching. Checking Southern Corn Leaf Blight:
Southern Corn Leaf Blight shows smaller, scattered lesions with reddish margins - different from the test image. Final view - Corn Stunt Spiroplasma:

All 8 views complete. Summary of comparison:

- **Stewart's Disease**: Near-identical match - same long bleached/pale tan streaks running parallel to veins on green leaf
- **Goss's Wilt**: Different - broad brown blight with wavy edges, no streaks
- **Gray Leaf Spot**: Different - small rectangular discrete lesions
- **Northern Leaf Blight**: Different - discrete cigar-shaped lesions
- **Maize Streak Virus**: Different - dense fine striping covering whole leaf
- **Maize Dwarf Mosaic Virus**: Different - mosaic/mottled pattern
- **Southern Corn Leaf Blight**: Different - small scattered reddish lesions
- **Corn Stunt Spiroplasma**: Different - purplish discoloration

The test image shows 2-3 long, pale yellow-tan bleached streaks running the full length of the leaf parallel to the veins, on an otherwise green leaf. This matches Stewart's Disease reference (Corn_Disease_38.jpg) almost exactly.
